verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: But what shall we say concerning David, to whom such testimony was borne, and of whom God said, “I have found a man after mine own heart, David the son of Jesse; and in everlasting mercy have I anointed him?”
verses.modernizedText: But what shall we say concerning David, to whom such testimony was borne, and of whom God said, “I have found a man after my own heart, David the son of Jesse; and in everlasting mercy have I anointed him?”

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: Yet this very man saith to God, “Have mercy on me, O Lord, according to Thy great mercy; and according to the multitude of Thy compassions, blot out my transgression.
verses.modernizedText: Yet this very man says to God, “Have mercy on me, O Lord, according to Your great mercy; and according to the multitude of Your compassions, blot out my transgression.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: Wash me still more from mine iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.
verses.modernizedText: Wash me still more from my iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: For I acknowledge mine iniquity, and my sin is ever before me.
verses.modernizedText: For I acknowledge my iniquity, and my sin is ever before me.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: Against Thee only have I sinned, and done that which is evil in Thy sight; that Thou mayest be justified in Thy sayings, and mayest overcome when Thou art judged.
verses.modernizedText: Against You only have I sinned, and done that which is evil in Your sight; that You may be justified in Your sayings, and may overcome when You are judged.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: For, behold, I was conceived in transgressions, and in sins did my mother conceive me.
verses.modernizedText: For, behold, I was conceived in transgressions, and in sins did my mother conceive me.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: For, behold, Thou hast loved truth; the secret and hidden things of wisdom hast Thou shown me.
verses.modernizedText: For, behold, You have loved truth; the secret and hidden things of wisdom have You shown me.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: Thou shalt sprinkle me with hyssop, and I shall be cleansed; Thou shalt wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.
verses.modernizedText: You shall sprinkle me with hyssop, and I shall be cleansed; You shall wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: Thou shalt make me to hear joy and gladness; my bones, which have been humbled, shall exult.
verses.modernizedText: You shall make me to hear joy and gladness; my bones, which have been humbled, shall exult.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: Turn away Thy face from my sins, and blot out all mine iniquities.
verses.modernizedText: Turn away Your face from my sins, and blot out all my iniquities.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew a right spirit within me.
verses.modernizedText: Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew a right spirit within me.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: Cast me not away from Thy presence, and take not Thy Holy Spirit from me.
verses.modernizedText: Cast me not away from Your presence, and take not Your Holy Spirit from me.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: Restore to me the joy of Thy salvation, and establish me by Thy governing Spirit.
verses.modernizedText: Restore to me the joy of Your salvation, and establish me by Your governing Spirit.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: I will teach transgressors Thy ways, and the ungodly shall be converted unto Thee.
verses.modernizedText: I will teach transgressors Your ways, and the ungodly shall be converted to You.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: Deliver me from blood-guiltiness, O God, the God of my salvation: my tongue shall exult in Thy righteousness.
verses.modernizedText: Deliver me from blood-guiltiness, O God, the God of my salvation: my tongue shall exult in Your righteousness.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: O Lord, Thou shalt open my mouth, and my lips shall show forth Thy praise.
verses.modernizedText: O Lord, You shall open my mouth, and my lips shall show forth Your praise.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: For if Thou hadst desired sacrifice, I would have given it; Thou wilt not delight in burnt-offerings.
verses.modernizedText: For if You had desired sacrifice, I would have given it; You will not delight in burnt-offerings.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: The sacrifice [acceptable] to God is a bruised spirit; a broken and a contrite heart God will not despise.”
verses.modernizedText: The sacrifice [acceptable] to God is a bruised spirit; a broken and a contrite heart God will not despise.”
